shared_elements: repeated short strokes or comb-like marks
justification: The only real overlap is that both surfaces include schematic animal-like forms and some repeated linear/geometric marks, with the closest correspondence being short parallel stroke clusters along or near curved lines. A is a dense, organized relief composition with recognizable profile animals and horizontal patterned bands, while B is a sparse set of red curvilinear signs with concentric-circle motifs and no comparable register structure or specific animal scheme.
